prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1194; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, muscle tightness, and limited range of motion. The reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar motion, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or ongoing complaints involving these body regions are known from the patient's history. Care consisted of 28 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency tapering as pain and mobility improved and the patient progressed toward discharge. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicated charges. Prognosis is good, with anticipated full resolution of symptoms and return to baseline activity expected within the coming weeks.
